title: The Sugar Sneak at Hollow Green
intro: Every morning the village bake sale table is missing a few treats, and the tin cash box has been left unlocked. Someone has been sneaking in after dark.

suspects.name: Tobias
suspects.line: Cake? I'd never touch cake. Well, not the iced ones.

suspects.name: Mabel
suspects.line: I bake for the sale, I don't steal from it. Ask my scones.

suspects.name: Oswin
suspects.line: Night walks are good for the knees. Nobody saw me, which is the point.

suspects.name: Ruth
suspects.line: I only came by to check the raffle. The raffle is fine.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was home asleep by nine. My cat will confirm it, sadly, he never talks.

clues.text: A chocolatey mug sat beside the tin, a marshmallow skin still floating in it. Whoever sipped from it was drinking hot cocoa.
A red bobble hat sat on the bench all evening, but its owner was by the duck pond the whole time. That hat was not the one seen at the table.
An apple juice carton lay behind the stall, but it was found hours before the treats went missing. Apple juice is not what the sneak was drinking.
Sticky fingerprints were found on the cake tin, left by someone wearing gloves. The sneak kept their hands clean.
